title: G03 content intelligence from topic, reference, or existing script to approved script
description: Stacked G03 implementation of persistent research, idea, story architecture, outline, script review, revision, and explicit approved-script contracts on the G02 ActionRun/checkpoint runtime.
businessContext: Creators need a traceable content-intelligence pipeline that reaches an explicitly approved script without creating Director or visual-production behavior.
dependencies: G02 base commit 0b4e8143ec76bb1f82e1254f8e059cca8e26f2c4; G03 remains stacked until G02 is merged.
acceptanceCriteria: Topic, Reference, and Existing Script modes reach an explicitly approved current script without fake-completing inapplicable checkpoints.
Research is consolidated in its checkpoint and preserves traceable transcript, segmentation, DNA, and opportunity artifacts.
Idea Lab produces exactly six validated, differentiated candidates; selection is explicit and invalidates downstream content artifacts.
Story Architecture, duration-aware Outline, structured versioned Script, separate Review, explicit Revision, user edits, and explicit Script Approval are persisted.
All content generation uses the G02 ActionRun/checkpoint runtime with honest progress, retry, fingerprints, stale invalidation, no duplicate requests, and no automatic paid reruns.
No Director, visual, image, voice, CapCut, FFmpeg, web-search, or crawler scope is introduced; structured text uses TextProvider.generateStructured().
Full repository verification and Electron click-through evidence pass.
humanEscalationConditions: The G02 base receives a required review fix before final G03 review.
A destructive migration or credential/paid live request is needed to continue.
G03 cannot be implemented without entering forbidden Director, visual, media, or web-research scope.
